_doc: Reviewed requests where the replay against STAGING cannot pass for a reason outside cmux-next: staging environment configuration, or a route production also no longer serves (a break cmux-old already has in production, not one a staging change made). cmux-old.ts replay accepts a listed request only when staging answers exactly this status, and reports it as a warning in the receipt. Every entry needs a reason and a date; remove it when the cause is fixed.
